desc:
🥚 STEAL A NINJA EGG 🥷

Sneak into the ninja temples, grab their eggs and RUN! 🏃💨

🔥 Steal eggs from 10 ninja zones, from the Brown Ninja's Dojo to Garmadon's Fortress
👹 Each zone has a giant boss guarding its eggs. Get back past the SAFE ZONE before it catches you!
🐣 Put your eggs in your pen, let them grow, then HATCH them into ninjas
💰 Your ninjas make money every second, even while you're away
🌪️ Train your Spinjitzu in your Spin Arena to get faster
⚡ Unlock new Spinjitzu styles in the Spinjitzu Shop
💥 Spin into other players to knock their eggs out of their hands!
📖 Collect every ninja form in the Index, from Common to Mythic
🌙 When night falls, all the eggs reset, so get there first!
🎁 Join the group to claim free Daily Rewards!

Can you steal the rarest Mythic eggs? 👀

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for more updates!
